title: Quenched Buttery Romantic Vietnamese Bacon Nem Nuong
description: This aerated, buttery nem nuong dish is a delicious twist on traditional Vietnamese cuisine, featuring crispy bacon and a rich, velvety sauce.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine fish sauce, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, and 1 tablespoon of butter. Heat over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the butter has melted and the sauce is smooth.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the egg yolks. Set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, cook the bacon over medium-high heat until crispy. Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter to the skillet and cook until melted. Add the shallots and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the cooked pork to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked bacon, sauce, and 1/4 cup of chopped cilantro to the pork mixture. Stir to combine.
Soak the rice paper wrappers in warm water for about 30 seconds, until pliable.
Assemble the nem nuong by placing a few tablespoons of the pork mixture onto a wrapper, then folding the wrapper into a triangle and securing with a toothpick. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the nem nuong hot, garnished with additional cilantro and sauce if desired.
To serve, place a few nem nuong on a plate, spoon some of the sauce over the top, and garnish with a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and a dash of sesame oil.
